card.name: Linking words in antiepileptic warning passages
card.fires_on: Small linking words (and, in) or the word increased inside the antiepileptic drug class warning on suicidality risk, and in the hyponatremia symptom list. The word sits just before the next item or noun in a repeated label sentence.

modes.label: Hyponatremia symptom list
modes.description: The word 'and' before the last symptom in a list of hyponatremia signs.

modes.label: Suicidality risk wording
modes.description: 'increased' or 'in' in the sentence about increased risk with antiepileptic drugs in younger patients.
modes.example: The finding of<< increased>> risk with AEDs of varying mechanisms
